item.title: Former Sycamore Brewing co-owner indicted on felony charges involving 13-year-old girl
item.description: A Stanly County grand jury has indicted the former co-owner of Sycamore Brewing on multiple felony charges connected to an alleged sexual assault involving a 13-year-old girl.

item.description: PICKENS COUNTY, S.C.
